# cloudsmith_policy (Resource)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the policy.
- `rego` (String) The rego source for the policy logic.
- `workspace` (String) Workspace the policy belongs to.

### Optional

- `description` (String) The description of the policy.
- `enabled` (Boolean) If true, the policy is enabled.
- `is_terminal` (Boolean) If true and the policy matches, no further policies are evaluated.
- `precedence` (Number) The order in which this policy is evaluated relative to other policies.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The time the policy was created.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `read_only` (Boolean) Whether the policy is read-only. Read-only policies still accept updates to their editable fields; the API rejects (422) any change to the policy's template shape.
- `slug_perm` (String) The policy's unique permanent slug.
- `updated_at` (String) The time the policy was last updated.
- `version` (Number) The version of the rego code.
